_comment: Reference plants for npm run validate:sizes -- --truth <this file> [--scan <scan id>]. One row per plant measured on the ground. diameterCm is required: the canopy's equivalent-circle diameter from a tape (average of two crossed widths) or a quadrat photo. Give at least one way to match the plant: plantId (the spot's id, shown at the bottom of its Measurements panel), or lat and lng from a receiver or a marker, or image (the camera's filename) with x and y (the canopy centre in the original's native pixels). areaCm2 when a quadrat or a traced photo gave it, else null. Twenty plants are needed before the verdict will call the accuracy measured. Delete this entry.

notes: example only: not a real measurement
